purpose: Repair the recurring Windows loopback POST transport failure without weakening Host, Origin, CSRF, replay or action-binding protections: normal-sized request bytes rejected before parsing are drained at the existing shell response boundary so Windows can deliver the intended HTTP rejection instead of aborting the local TCP connection.

lineage.outcome: A local N0TE action that is correctly rejected by security policy still returns its truthful HTTP rejection reliably on Windows instead of intermittently collapsing into a socket abort, while rejected actions remain unauthorized and unconsumed.
lineage.capability: Cross-platform local consumer-shell transport reliability for bounded rejected POST requests

why_now: INC-2026-09-03-WINDOWS-LOOPBACK-RECURRENCE-001 explicitly reopened this transport class after repeated Windows-only loopback failures. The same WinError 10053 signature recurred during later exact-head verification of unrelated Song work. No other workline owned loopback transport reliability when this bounded repair was selected.

implementation_contract.security_order: Existing handlers decide rejection before cleanup. The extension only drains raw bounded bytes after the response decision and never parses, authorizes or consumes an action token.
implementation_contract.bounded_drain: Only POST bodies with a non-negative Content-Length within the existing form-size ceiling and no Transfer-Encoding are eligible. Unknown, malformed, chunked or oversized bodies are never trusted as normal form input.
implementation_contract.response_semantics: Existing HTTP status codes, response bodies and user-visible security meaning remain unchanged.
implementation_contract.action_semantics: A hostile-Origin attempt does not consume its one-shot action; a later valid request may still use the exact action once, after which replay remains rejected.
implementation_contract.composition: Install through N0TE's existing shell-extension composition pattern so base and later-added POST routes share one transport cleanup behavior without duplicating route dispatch.
implementation_contract.platform_semantics: The repair is platform-neutral product code. Windows recurrence motivated the repair but did not create a Windows-specific N0TE semantic fork.

completion_proof: real loopback regression repeats bounded hostile-Origin POST rejection 64 times without socket abort and receives HTTP 403
real loopback regression repeats bounded unknown-route rejection 16 times and receives HTTP 404
real loopback regression repeats unsupported normal-sized media rejection 16 times and receives HTTP 403
all rejected requests leave the exact one-shot profile action untouched; the valid local Origin consumes it once and replay remains 409
no profile or action authority is created by rejected request bytes
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at exact heads on Linux, Windows and macOS

evidence_snapshot.execution_note: The bounded repair passed first-attempt exact-head governance, full regression and staged consumer smoke on all three peer platforms at the original implementation, closure, and a later disjoint-main reconstruction.
